mapper.select: SELECT sl.seq AS logSeq, sl.survey_seq AS surveySeq, sl.occur_date AS startDate, sl_end.occur_date AS endDate, (sl_end.occur_date - sl.occur_date) * 24 * 60 * 60 AS responseTime FROM survey_log sl JOIN survey_log sl_end ON sl.survey_seq = sl_end.survey_seq WHERE sl.cc_seq = 23 AND sl_end.cc_seq = 31 AND (sl_end.occur_date - sl.occur_date) * 86400 >= #{threshold} ORDER BY sl.survey_seq, sl.occur_date;
